name: Reviews slider
purpose: Builds trust late on a page by cycling through several customer reviews, then pushes to the demo.
description: Centred H2 above a 60rem one-slide-at-a-time carousel. Each slide is a tall dark panel (min 32.5rem, 35rem <=479) with a customer logo top-left, a customer image pinned top-right, and at the bottom a 28px quote plus a 3rem-avatar author row; `order` puts the author first (content, corporate, integrations, professional services, whats-included) or the quote first (/lms/features/*). Inactive slides sit at scale .65 / opacity .5. Prev/next round arrows overlap the slider's bottom-right corner, and a centred primary button follows. With `slides=[]` (the CMS empty state on /lms/features/employee-experience and /lms/features/communication) the slider is replaced by a single 'No items found.' bar while the heading, arrows and button stay.

motion.reducedMotionNote: The schema REQUIRES this fallback on every generated node. Neither the original site nor the clone implements prefers-reduced-motion; this is a generation-time requirement, not a description of the source.
motion.note: Loop carousel autoplays from mount (4s after each settle, Swiper waitForTransition semantics), pauses while hovered and during drag; track slides 800ms ease; the active slide scales .65->1 and fades .5->1 over 600ms ease; arrows change colour over 320ms. No autoplay and no carousel in the empty state.
